security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI saves/restores or inspects CHERI capability state (during context switch, HSM suspend/resume, or SBI call handler) using hardcoded field positions from the old default encoding instead of first reading uycfg CSR to determine the active capability encoding format and applying format-specific decode/validate/encode logic, causing capability metadata corruption when the hardware uses an encoding format other than the one OpenSBI assumes.
security_spec.summary: Multi-encoding-format CHERI capability spec requires OpenSBI to query uycfg and adapt save/restore/validation to the active encoding format; hardcoding field offsets from any single encoding silently corrupts capability tags, bounds, and permissions across privilege boundaries.
